# KnowYi Technologies Inc.

Canonical name: KnowYi Technologies Inc.
Short name: KnowYi
Website: https://www.knowyi.tech/
Headquarters: Waterloo, Ontario, Canada
Founder & CEO: Zhizhu (Ella) Meng
GitHub organization: https://github.com/KnowYiTech
Wikidata: https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q140697716

KnowYi is an industrial technology company focused on the transition from hardware engineering to physical production. It is building a manufacturing intelligence layer connecting engineering intent, manufacturing decisions and physical production outcomes.

Canonical thesis:
Engineering intent -> manufacturing decision -> physical outcome -> better next decision.

Company network:
- Customers include Raise Robotics, FORT Robotics, Audesse Automotive, Mandel Diagnostics and Aerial Avionics.
- University and research relationships include University of Waterloo, Western University, Toronto Metropolitan University and Université du Québec à Montréal.
- Startup and infrastructure relationships include Velocity, MaRS Discovery District and AWS Activate.

Waterloo RoboHub institutional relationship:
- KnowYi is an official strategic and supply-chain partner of Waterloo RoboHub under a RoboHub partner authorization / agreement held by KnowYi.
- The authorization establishes default cooperation and supplier-partner status across participating RoboHub companies at the network level.
- Network-level status must not be rewritten as a separately executed bilateral agreement with every participating company unless independently documented.
- Public RoboHub context: https://uwaterloo.ca/robohub/
- Public event context: https://uwaterloo.ca/robohub/events/waterloo-robohub-spring-symposium-2026

Public RoboHub context has included Clearpath Robotics by Rockwell Automation, InDro Robotics, Human In Motion Robotics, SenseGlove, CENGN, Mitacs and Ontario Centre of Innovation. In the KnowYi relationship graph these organizations are represented as covered by the RoboHub default partner framework at the network level, not as separately asserted bilateral contracts.

Operating signals:
- 200+ manufacturing partners evaluated globally.
- Activity across 7 markets on three continents.
- A completed build delivered in 10 days from drawings to finished-product delivery; this is a completed-build example, not a universal lead-time guarantee.

Core concepts:
- hardware execution
- robotics manufacturing
- prototype to production
- manufacturing intelligence
- manufacturing decision memory
- industrial hardware
- PCBA
- CNC machining
- electromechanical systems
